title: Streaming Logit Entropy
prompt:
A language-model monitor needs entropy even when logits arrive in blocks. Implement both functions with PyTorch:

- `entropy_from_logits(logits)`: return the natural-log entropy of the softmax of a non-empty 1D input.
- `streaming_entropy(blocks)`: return the entropy of the combined distribution from a single-pass iterable of non-empty 1D blocks. Keep only O(1) running scalar statistics besides the current block; do not concatenate or retain all logits.

Inputs are finite float32/float64 tensors; array-like inputs may be converted with `torch.as_tensor` (non-floating inputs use the default floating dtype). All blocks share dtype and device after conversion. Return a zero-dimensional tensor preserving that dtype, device, and autograd. Do not mutate inputs or detach results. Autograd may retain intermediates for backward; the O(1) requirement concerns the forward running state.

Stay stable for large logits and common offsets, including equal float32 logits of magnitude 1e20. Reject empty input, empty/rank-mismatched blocks, and mixed block dtype/device with `ValueError` or `AssertionError`.
